groups.note: Municipal names are keyed from official Park generals beginning in 2016; school and most special-district names are keyed from official generals beginning in 2020. Earlier January seats in those groups are marked Not yet collected rather than invented. The official 2018 Frannie mayoral contest is a 1–1 tie (R. Vance Peregoy and Marty Roedel) and is not filled. The official 2024 Cody Conservation District at-large contest is write-in only (785 write-in totals, no named winner) and is not filled; Carmen Horne-McIntyre appears on the official March 2026 roster in a 2-year unexpired seat and won the official 2026 at-large election. The official 2022 Meeteetse Conservation rural contest and the official 2020 Meeteetse Conservation 2-year at-large contest have no named official winner and are not filled. The official Park Clerk elections page certifies Bethany Winzenried as the write-in elected to the Meeteetse Museum District Director race (included) and Kerstin Harley as the write-in elected in the Park County School District #16 2-year race; the official 2026 general summary names Sarah McKergow as the Vote-For-1 winner (150–57 write-in totals) and does not name Harley — the canvass figures are used and the page text is flagged. Official 2024 Frannie council was a 6–4–4 result (Ganoung, Clendenen, DeSantis); the official roster lists Ganoung and Clendenen in the 2028 seats.

groups.note: Supreme Court justices and the Chancery Court judge are the people in office this January, from official Wyoming Judicial Branch dates and official retention results (shared with other counties). Local rows are 5th Judicial District judges who appeared by name on a Park County official retention ballot. The official 2018 general lists district and circuit retentions with no judge’s name; those are not attached to people. Park is in the 5th Judicial District (with Big Horn, Hot Springs, and Washakie); 4th and 6th Judicial District judges are not copied here.
